description: Defines the QhullFacetSet class, a set of Qhull facets, including constructors, conversion methods, filtering, and IO operations.

classes.name: QhullFacetSet
classes.description: A C++ class representing a set of Qhull facets, with filtering, conversion, and IO capabilities.

methods.name: QhullFacetSet
methods.description: Constructors for QhullFacetSet, including from Qhull and setT*.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying pointers and select_all flag.

methods.name: toStdVector
methods.description: Converts the set to a std::vector of QhullFacet.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of facets, optionally filtered by isGood.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific QhullFacet is in the set.

methods.name: isSelectAll
methods.description: Returns whether all facets, including bad ones, are selected.

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Selects all facets, including bad ones.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Returns a PrintFacetSet object for printing with a message.

methods.name: printIdentifiers
methods.description: Returns a PrintIdentifiers object for printing identifiers with a message.
